standard_prerequisites.name: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme the global sections functor on quasi-coherent complexes has finite cohomological dimension
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the integer N that controls how far up the cone can contribute after taking sections.

standard_prerequisites.name: Any pseudo-coherent complex on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme admits an approximation by a perfect complex up to any prescribed degree
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the perfect complex P and the cone C whose low cohomology sheaves agree with E.

core_obligations: Choose N with RGamma(X, -) : D_QCoh(O_X) to D(A) of cohomological dimension N as in Lemma quasi-coherence-direct-image, and b with H^i(K) = 0 for i > b; it suffices to show RGamma(X, E tensor^L K) is m-pseudo-coherent for every m (proof lines 8874-8882).
Approximate E by a perfect complex P of (X, E, m - N - 1 - b), possible by Theorem approximation, and complete to a distinguished triangle P to E to C to P[1] in D_QCoh(O_X) (proof lines 8882-8888).

Degree bookkeeping: the cohomology sheaves of C vanish in degrees >= m - N - 1 - b, so those of C tensor^L K vanish in degrees >= m - N - 1 (K is bounded above by b), and hence the cohomology of RGamma(X, C tensor^L K) vanishes in degrees >= m - 1 by cohomological dimension N (proof lines 8889-8895).

Conclude: the long exact sequence makes RGamma(X, P tensor^L K) to RGamma(X, E tensor^L K) an isomorphism on cohomology in degrees >= m; the source is pseudo-coherent by assumption (P is perfect), so the target is m-pseudo-coherent, and since m was arbitrary the proof is complete (proof lines 8895-8902).
proof_roadmap: Fix the cohomological dimension N and the bound b for K (proof lines 8874-8882).
Approximate E by a perfect complex up to degree m - N - 1 - b (proof lines 8882-8888).
Kill the cone by degree bookkeeping through tensoring and sections (proof lines 8889-8895).
Transfer m-pseudo-coherence from P to E for every m (proof lines 8895-8902).
